correctness.rationale: For every fixed real ν>0 and all sufficiently large decreasingly indexed nodal intervals of K_{iν}, the first positive-zero indexing follows from the nonvanishing phase-monotone I_{iν} Wronskian and continuous Γ phase. The exact Turán normalization T=(ν²+z²)/x²−1, Riccati z′=−xT and stationarity 1+(1+z)T=0 imply z(α)=−1−1/τ. Uniform oscillatory small-x series with s=ν log(2/x)+ην gives z=−ν cot s+x²[ν² csc²s/(4A)+(1+ν cot s)/(2A)]+Oν(x⁴), A=1+ν². At s=nπ+atanν the x² coefficient is 1/4+1/A; implicit differentiation (A/ν≠0) fixes c=(A+8)/(4A²) in α=q(1+cq²+O(q⁴)), q=2 exp[(ην−nπ−atanν)/ν]. Then exact τ=A/α²+2/A−1+O(α²) gives τ=A/q²−3/2−2/A+O(q²). Independent high-precision mpmath critical-point solutions at ν=1.25, n=2,3,4 confirm convergence of normalized q⁴ and q² errors. Bounds are fixed-ν, not uniform ν→0,∞. Script check.py was read, not treated as proof.
